compatibility_notes: Second code on the existing generic 1206 22 nF capacitor: the plain generic ID keeps its reviewed preference C1856 (FH 1206B223K500NT, X7R +/-10% 50 V). C1931 is the exact FH Y5V +/-20% SKU (1206F223M500NT, 50 V) from the same maker, so it gets its own maker/mpn variant ID linked via generic_oomp_id, following the established variant taxonomy. Two-terminal MLCC (pin_count 2); stock 543 recorded as observed. Edits made under the capacitor family lock.
